summary: scripts/st-test no longer walks every pool tree with du at each start: a run that releases its tree records what the tree and its target hold (tree-N.size, beside the lock), a start sums the records, and a tree is walked only when its record is missing or older than a change to it and only when the recorded sum is within 80% of ST_TEST_POOL_MAX_GB.
